posts.text: My administration is closely monitoring the situation following the multi-vehicle crash involving a MTA bus in Baltimore County. Dawn and I are keeping everyone impacted in our hearts and prayers. We are deeply grateful for our first responders who acted with speed and skill to ensure the safety of our neighbors. We’ve been in close coordination with local officials to provide any support needed on the ground.

posts.text:
Patriotism asks you to fight for values and an ideal. 

Nationalism asks you to fight for a person or group. 

There's a difference, and it matters.
posts.summary: Distinguishes patriotism from nationalism, criticizes nationalist ideology
posts.quote:
Patriotism asks you to fight for values and an ideal. 

Nationalism asks you to fight for a person or group. 

There's a difference, and it matters.

posts.text:
My grandfather gave me one last gift before he passed away: a Bible.

Inside, he wrote four words: "Have faith, not fear."

Fear is the accelerant of nationalism. Faith is the foundation of patriotism.

Let’s choose faith.
posts.summary: Frames faith as antidote to fear and nationalism, advocates choosing faith
